name: Shell SDF
aliases: Unsigned offset field of Xu & Barbic
definition: An unsigned distance field minus a shell half-thickness. Negative within `shell_voxels` of any triangle, positive beyond. Works on open, non-manifold, self-intersecting, and inconsistently wound meshes. Extracts a thin solid around every triangle: two walls around an open sheet, and an outer surface plus an inner one for a closed solid.
